comment: Upstream tests that fail on the plain nightly without any patch. A failure counts as passed only when its file and full name match an entry and the patches leave that test's source unchanged. Remove an entry once `status` reports it stale. See docs/machines.md, Unattended ports.

failures.test: MessagesTimeline messages > keeps the visible sentence in a long message when the chat width changes
failures.note: Fails only on the MacBook Air (macOS 27.2.1, headless Chromium 1248), also on the plain nightly 0.1.12-nightly.20261125.5230: the sentence moves 341px instead of under 30. Passes on devbox1 and the MacBook Pro, so a stale mark there does not mean the Air passes.
